name: Singulus Technologies AG
summary: Singulus Technologies AG develops and assembles machines and systems for thin-film coating and surface treatment processes in Germany, rest of Europe, North and South America, and Asia. It operates through three segments: Solar, Life Science, and Semiconductor. The company offers solutions for crystalline solar cells, including heterojunction technology and TopCON, as well as thin-film technologies based on copper-indium-gallium-selenide and cadmium telluride; system concepts to produce tandem solar cells; and supplies production lines for the manufacture of solar cells and solar modules.
